exposure: Abnormal fetal middle cerebral artery (MCA) Doppler
outcome: Admission to neonatal intensive care unit (NICU)
cohort: 100 high-risk pregnant women with various pregnancy complications
finding: Abnormal Doppler findings were associated with an increased rate of low birth weight and admissions to the NICU but had no effect on preterm delivery or cesarean section rates.
birth_weight: Low birth weight (<2.5 kg) was significantly associated with abnormal Doppler findings.
